text:
oncall-bot: ⚠️ Incident detected: elevated 5xx rate in inference-prod-west. threshold breach: 2.3% -> 14%. Pager triggered.

alex_m: seeing repeated segfaults from model-runner-3 (coredump). taking point. pulling logs now.

samira: grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/inf-prod -> 5xx spike at 08:12 UTC. stack traces show SIGSEGV in quant_attention.o.

benji: logs snippet:
```
[08:12:34] model-runner-3 pid=23145 SIGSEGV at 0x7f8c...
#0 0x7f8c1234 in quant_attn_forward
#1 0x7f8b5678 in model_infer_loop
```

maria-sre: customer-ops - any customer reports?

customer-ops: two support tickets and a backend alert from AcmeCorp. users seeing 502/gateway timeouts. posting the advisory now.

alex_m: immediate mitigations: (1) roll back recent quant build from v1.7 -> v1.6 on prod-west; (2) enable fallback routing to small-model-compat for 20% of traffic if error rate > 5%. executing rollback now.

samira: command run: `kubectl set image deploy/model-runner model-runner=registry/redwood/model-runner:v1.6 -n prod-west`

benji: scaling pool while rollback completes: `kubectl scale --replicas=12 deploy/model-runner -n prod-west` (done). applying hotpatch id hotpatch-8476 to suppress failing kernel path.

oncall-bot: Incident ticket created INC-84765. Paging support rotation: @maria-sre, @benji, @alex_m.

maria-sre: watching metrics — 5xx down to 7.2% after rollback start. latency stable.

customer-ops: status update posted: "Investigating increased errors, mitigation in progress. Some requests may be routed to fallback model."

alex_m: flipped gateway route rule to fallback-model for up to 25% traffic while health-checks continue. config snippet:
```json
{"route":"/v1/*","fallback":"small-model-compat","threshold":0.05}
```

samira: hotpatch applied but will keep rollback as primary until we validate kernel fix. capturing core dumps to storage: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-84765/cores/

benji: error rate trending down — now 1.1% in prod-west at 08:18 UTC. hotpatch + rollback appear effective.

maria-sre: confirming customer impact: AcmeCorp ticket updated, they reported retrying succeeded.

alex_m: opening post-incident follow-up: root cause likely regression in quant attention kernel in v1.7. will run targeted unit tests and staging repro. assigning to eng-ml.

customer-ops: sending final status: "Mitigation applied; traffic stabilized. Postmortem to follow." :white_check_mark: 

benji: creating follow-up task TASK-12844 for kernel regression trace and test coverage.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-84765 resolved by alex_m at 8476543265. Closing page.

maria-sre: nice job team. will coordinate postmortem and customer comms. :thumbsup:
